name: Morrowgrain to Darnassus
label: Quest
description: Morrowgrain to Darnassus: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The Arch Druid is always looking for additional morrowgrain for the Cenarion Circle's continued research. We take them in increments of ten, and award you with a cache of goods you should find useful. When you have ten, let me know and I will reward you accordingly.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent - this morrowgrain will no doubt please the Arch Druid. I must admit though... Just being near them makes me feel a little uncomfortable. I can only imagine how difficult it is for the Arch Druid to tolerate them in such large numbers!
This is for you, friend. The Cenarion Circle thanks you for your continued support.
